text.en: Canada's huge northern region raises challenges of security and sovereignty.
text.fr: L'immense région nordique du Canada pose des défis de sécurité et de souveraineté.

source.quote: Canada’s vast north brings security and sovereignty challenges.

Drawing on indigenous knowledge and experience, the Rangers travel by snowmobile in the winter and all-terrain vehicles in the summer from Resolute to the Magnetic North Pole, and keep the flag flying in Canada’s Arctic.

text.en: The Canadian Rangers draw on indigenous knowledge and experience.

text.fr: L'été, les Rangers canadiens se déplacent en véhicules tout-terrain et, l'hiver, ils voyagent en motoneige.
